_README: Per-test wall-clock time budgets for the coop suite, in seconds. Read verbatim
by BOTH runners: tools/ci/run_coop_suite.ps1 (the CI shard runner) and
tools/coop_test/run_parallel.py (the local K-lane runner). This file is the
single source of truth -- keep the two parsers agreeing by editing only here.
* Every test gets default_budget_s unless it is listed under 'exceptions'.
* A test that FINISHES over its budget FAILS the suite even if it passed
('BUDGET EXCEEDED') -- re-engineer the test or add a justified exception.
* A test still running at hard_kill_multiplier x its budget is killed (with
the game subtree it spawned) and failed ('BUDGET HARD-KILL'), so a hung
test can never wedge a shard now that the CI step wall-clock timeout is gone.
* No exception may exceed max_budget_s. There are no unlimited budgets; the
runners hard-error on load if an exception is over the cap.
Each exception carries the observed CI duration in its 'reason'.
Give exceptions headroom: CI runners are slower and contended vs local.
